resolved_findings.title: Preserve executable mode on the Goose snapshot
resolved_findings.why_it_matters: Every staged Goose binary becomes mode 0444, so the worker cannot execute /goose and its subprocess.Popen fails with PermissionError before any task runs. The source file previously retained its executable mode through the bind. Give the Goose snapshot an explicitly approved executable mode while keeping data snapshots read-only.
